slices.title: Bundle size budget: profile key, preflight check, test, rules row

questions.question: Are the keys of budgets.bundleBytes exact project-relative paths or globs?
questions.chosen: Exact project-relative paths; globs can be added later without breaking this shape.

questions.question: What happens when a named file does not exist?
questions.chosen: Skipped and listed in the details, because a build output may not exist yet at preflight time.

questions.question: Is size measured raw or gzipped?
questions.chosen: Raw bytes on disk, as the key name says bytes; no compression step.
